speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I am going, Master Shakespeare. Church hat. I have never been inside a playhouse, and I will not have that said of me for a second winter if the thing is to be played at two.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The yard is full by one, if the cold holds. I did not ask you. I am glad of the hat, and I am not selling you a sermon about it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I am not buying a sermon. I am going where a woman can sit and still be a woman of this parish. Alse comes if she can keep her tongue in her head for the length of it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I can keep it. I will not ask a question in the street. I asked about the moon on Tuesday. I am not asking another.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I am at the loom, Mistress. A playhouse is not a place I have a coat for, and the beam will not wait because Bishopsgate has a tragedy.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the loom has you, Gillis, and the gallery has me. I want no procession. I want a stair, and a place, and to be home before the streets invent a story about a widow at a play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Goodwife Pell has the lower gallery stair. She knows the faces. I am not naming a price for your seat. If there is a price, it is between you and the stair, and I will not hear it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I did not ask you what it costs. A woman who asks the poet the price of his own door is a fool, and I am not one. The hat is the good one. It will have to do.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I carry the cloak, Mistress, or will you say I am in the way of the hat?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will carry yourself, and you will sit beside me, and you will not translate the play for me while it is happening. I have ears. I have used them on his walking for a month.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am gone before you. I speak the first of it alone. If you are in by one, you will see a swan on the flag and a yard that already knows where it is going. I cannot walk you there. I am wanted before the doors.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I am not a parcel to be walked. We know the way to Shoreditch as well as a player does, and we will not arrive on your arm as if the play were a wedding.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will bolt nothing before the bell. If you are later than you think, Mistress, the kitchen will still be a kitchen.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: We will not be later than I think. Once is a thing I have decided. I am not discussing a second time at breakfast. Mark me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once, then. I will not tell you what to think of it, and I will not ask you tonight what you thought. The door can have whatever words it has. I am not writing them for you.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will sit beside her. I will keep my hands in my lap. That is the sentence.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sit, Alse. That is enough to carry.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Eat the heel if you are eating. The loaf is still short, and the play will not lengthen it. We leave when the hat is pinned, and not when a speech is finished.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Give you a full house, Master Shakespeare.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Give you a quiet loom, Gillis. Mistress, I will see the hat, or I will not. Either is the truth of the afternoon.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will see it. Come, Alse. The pin, and then the street, and no more questions than the one you already spent.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The pin, then. I have it. I am not asking where we sit until we are on the stair and she tells me.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will keep the fire small. A full house does not need this kitchen to blaze in sympathy.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Small is right. I am gone.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The pin is in. Gillis, the fire stays small. Alse, the street.
